_guide: Public archive. Each published record has an original PDF or image. Keep exact filename casing; use the date printed on the document. TOEIC point values come from the archived filenames; the attached diplomas are institutional Bronze recognitions. See docs/CREDENTIALS.md.

certificates.title: Microsoft Excel Expert
certificates.subtitle: MOS · Microsoft 365 Apps
certificates.description: Passed the Microsoft Excel Expert (Microsoft 365 Apps) exam with a score of 972/1000, above the required score of 700. The score report covers workbook options and settings, data management and formatting, advanced formulas and macros, and advanced charts and tables.
